name: Spotify Now Playing
description: Display what's currently playing on Spotify directly via the Spotify Web API.
author: FiestaBoard

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: Your Spotify application Client ID (from developer.spotify.com/dashboard)

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: OAuth refresh token obtained during setup (see Setup Guide)

refresh_seconds.title: Refresh Interval (seconds)
refresh_seconds.description: How often to check for now playing updates. Lower values = more real-time but more API calls.

show_album.title: Show Album Name
show_album.description: Include album name in the formatted output

env_vars.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_ID
env_vars.description: Spotify application Client ID (can also be set in UI)

env_vars.name: SPOTIFY_CLIENT_SECRET
env_vars.description: Spotify application Client Secret (can also be set in UI)

env_vars.name: SPOTIFY_REFRESH_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Spotify OAuth refresh token (can also be set in UI)
